title: Charlie Kirk funeral mixes rally and revival as mourners vow to spread Maga message
summary: Emotions were raw as service began with Christian worship songs – and ended with a political speech from the president Hours before sunrise in the desert, tens of thousands of mourners snaked through the Valley toward the State Farm stadium in Glendale, Arizona – where the conservative activist Charlie Kirk was lionized as a “prophet” for the streaming era and a defender of free speech, martyred in the line of duty. The memorial was part spiritual revival and part political rally, with the program that included Donald Trump and prominent members of the president’s Make America Great Again (Maga) movement. Mourners obliged the red, white and blue “Sunday best” dress code request, filling the at-capacity domed stadium with stars, stripes and Maga hats. Continue reading...

title: Trump calls Charlie Kirk 'martyr now for American freedom' at memorial service
summary: At a service focused on Kirk's conservative Christian faith, President Trump described the late 31-year-old as the "greatest evangelist for American liberty" as Kirk's widow forgave the alleged gunman.
